pricing.primary: Actual two-hop V3 TWAP adapter and pool observations
pricing.secondary: Test-controlled instantaneous spot price, not an independent production source
pricing.counterfactual: Snapshot-isolated immediate liquidation with only the TWAP response mocked to the correct post-gap spot; full state and mock restored before delay measurement

inactiveMarket.lenderMaxWithdrawAndMaxRedeem: 0 while debt remains and pricing is unavailable

limitations: Passing assertions demonstrate the delay and loss behavior; they do not approve these parameters
One pinned block, one borrower and roughly 95 USDG principal per scenario
A responsive secondary is modeled, not sourced independently; both inputs ultimately depend on the same DEX
First executable quote is measured on a 60-second grid, not exact earliest inclusion time
Synthetic whale inventory moves prices via real swaps; trade costs are not a net attack-cost model
Periodic real trades refresh observation writes and slightly move both pools; no arbitrage is modeled
No sequencer outage, MEV, adverse keeper latency, full L2 fee calculation or larger/concurrent liquidation stress
Without new pool writes, the test proves blockage at 3601 seconds, not a finite recovery bound
